title: Synapse gets very confused if the prev_events in a make_join response predate your most recent leave event

labels.name: A-Workers
labels.description: Problems related to running Synapse in Worker Mode (or replication)

labels.name: S-Major
labels.description: Major functionality / product severely impaired, no satisfactory workaround.

labels.name: T-Defect
labels.description: Bugs, crashes, hangs, security vulnerabilities, or other reported issues.

labels.name: O-Uncommon
labels.description: Most users are unlikely to come across this or unexpected workflow

body:
See https://github.com/matrix-org/sytest/issues/918#issuecomment-669613247. Basically, if you leave and rejoin a room too quickly, then the remote server might send you a make_join response whose prev_events predate your leave event, which seems to make synapse explode horribly.

Initially it returns a `404 - Unknown room` (which is bogus in itself), but subsequent attempts to join (even with a prev_events) result in an ISE:
